column3: “Utterly bring to an end” is rendered “completely remove,” and “ground” “earth.”
“The stumbling-blocks” is rendered “the ruins”; “ground” is rendered “earth.” The meaning of the phrase is uncertain.
“From after the LORD” is rendered “from following the LORD,” and the second “sought” “inquired of.”
“Visit” is rendered “punish”; “clothed clothing foreign” is rendered “clothe themselves with foreign garments.”
“Leaps over the threshold” is rendered “leap on the temple threshold,” supplying “temple”; “lords” (plural) is rendered “lord.”
“The gate of the fishes” is rendered “the Fish Gate,” and “second district” “Second Quarter.”
“Visit” is rendered “punish”; “thickening on their lees” is rendered “stagnant in spirit.”
“The sound of” is rendered “Listen”; NASB renders “bitter is shouting out there a warrior” as “In it the warrior cries out bitterly.”
“The corners, the high” is rendered “the high corner towers.”
“A terrible thing” is rendered “a terrifying one”; NASB adds “Indeed.”
